title: Joiner, mover, leaver and what each phase needs
desc: Three phases in order. A joiner enters the scope of needing access and gets birthright access: the baseline from attributes such as department and location, kept small. A mover moves between boundaries that need different access, such as Sales to Marketing; the quiet risk is that old access stays and privilege accumulates, so NIST SP 800-53 PS-5 requires reviewing the ongoing need on reassignment. A leaver leaves the scope, and every surface needs checking, not one status flipped. Treating the HR event as the trigger for all three is the usual design, not Microsoft's rule.
